title: TaskWhoRelation - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between a task and a lead or contacts. This object is available in API version 29.0 and later.

AccountId.description: Indicates the Account ID of the relation. For information on IDs, see ID Field Type.

RelationId.description: Indicates the ID of the contacts or lead related to the task.

TaskId.description: Indicates the ID of the task.

Type.description: Indicates whether the person related to the task is a lead or contact.

usage:
Here's a Java example that queries contacts associated with a task.

queryWhosOfTaskSample

"SELECT Id, Subject, (SELECT RelationId, Relation.Name, IsWhat from TaskWhoRelations) FROM Task WHERE Id = '00Tx0000005OKEN'"
